dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible with high-contrast white perimeters (approx. 5-10 pixels wide) and dark interior cores. The gradient is sharpest at the outer perimeter and transitions into a diffuse interior. Prominent examples include a closed circular ring mid-left and several large 'C' shapes in the central-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a moderate density of small, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the lower-left quadrant and interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral extending across the mid-horizontal axis of the animal. A tight triangular relationship is formed by three high-intensity blobs located near the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, jagged linear white feature approximately one-fifth the total length of the visible body is present along the upper-right dorsal ridge, distinct from the circular patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple macro-annuli in the central-right region exhibit overlapping perimeters, creating a chain-like or 'linked' visual texture.
